verdicts.reason: Both layouts are almost the same: the 'Shop Flavours' button floats on the right, stacked between the subhead and the flavour pills instead of sitting with the copy, and the logo and headline sit on top of the decorative circles. In A, the oversized headline runs within about 40px of the right edge while the left margin is about 74px, and the button is jammed above the pills with an edge that doesn't line up with anything. B keeps a calmer headline size, lines the button up with the left edge of the HONEY ROSEMARY pill and spaces the pills evenly, though its button is on the small side for the main call to action.
